text.name: Dayton Accords
text.rules: Record "peace enforced". LIO spends 2 points. At the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: The Bosnian peace agreement was initialled at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base near Dayton, Ohio on 21 November 1995 and signed in Paris on 14 December 1995, ending a war that had lasted since 1992.
